title: I Saved FOUR Years Of Frozen Seconds ⏸️
description:
Everyone here can freeze the world for one second a day. My uncle uses his on falling cakes. The lady next door uses hers on the same pigeon every morning.

I saved mine for four years, for the day my best friend Leo moves away. Then I froze the park at noon, and something else was still moving.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: When did Leo start moving in the frozen world? Watch his pretzel.
